'''Polard Manfred''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] individual who owned his own [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was captured while flying his YT-1300 in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]].<ref name="SWG:CPM" />
